text: Let's grab a coffee together today. Are you free this afternoon?
What time is it? The train leaves at half past seven, so please hurry up!
This is my dog. His name is Max. We are leaving now.
Hello! My name is Anna and I'm from Boston. What's your name?
Mr. Brown and Dr. Lee bought fruit, e.g. apples and pears.
I can't come tonight, but we'll see each other tomorrow, won't we?
We need bread, milk, eggs, cheese and a few tomatoes.
When you learn a new language, it helps to practice a little every day, even if it is only ten minutes.
Well — I'm not sure… maybe next week.
